page.running_head: De agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: agro jam sint, non sint obnoxiæ stapulæ juri, easque emere, vendere, commutare inter se agrariis liceat: exceptis equis, hinnulis, bubus, vaccis, trimestre longiusve tempus in agro pastis, qui in agro natis accenseri & fori oppidani juri subjecti esse debent. In agro nata & stapulæ subjecta non alia censeri debent quàm hæc: butyrum, caseus, equi, pulli, boves, vaccæ, triticum, secale, hordeum, avena, far: atque hæc omninò, ni antè promercalia Groningæ fuerint, distrahere in agro licitum non sit. Sub iis, quæ in usum rei familiaris vendere & emere licet, etiam ea comprehendantur, quæ lanij, pistores, propolæ, aut institores in usum rei suæ in agro coëmunt, ut minutim rursum vendant. Agrarius peregrino vendens res suas fori juri subjectas immunis à pœna sit, nisi confiteritur, scisse, peregrinum esse, quo cum contraxit. Hovetmanni ab oppidanis electi, ab Ordinibus totius provinciæ potestatem judicandi accipiant, & iis, ac apud eos sacramento se obligent ex formâ solenni, in sententia ascripta, Antè hoc sacramentum præstitum Hovetmanni pro Hovetmannis non habeantur, & acta eorum velut non acta

page.notes: Scan is slightly blurred at the top left and right edges. Doubtful readings: "confiteritur" (the first letters are faint), "scisse" (printed with long s, read as plain s), and "Groningæ" (final letter uncertain). The word "acta" at the end of the text is the catchword, repeated. The paragraph is not broken on this page; it runs on from the previous page and does not end here. The marks in the margins are specks and printer's dirt, not notes. Page with a Google watermark at bottom right, not transcribed.
